title: Is stock price prediction possible? Dr Author-C answers!
description:
🔴 NEXT LIVE SESSION: Claude for Algo Trading, Tuesday 18 August, 7 PM IST. Watch Claude turn a plain-English trading idea into a systematic, testable strategy, live, with Ishan Shah and Sanya Modi. Register Here: https://bit.ly/4g0hwkP In this video, Dr Author-C addresses the following question: Some researchers have said that stock market prices are like a random walk. Is it even possible or done by someone when it comes to a prices prediction? What are the suitable input parameters for a model tasked to do this? 

For the answer, catch the complete video above.

Don't forget to 'Like' and 'Share' this video and to 'Subscribe' to our YouTube channel!
-----------------------------------------
This video clip is from our webinar Machine Learning in Trading Q&A by Dr. Author-C: https://youtu.be/m4BFOSaos7M
-----------------------------------------
About the speaker:
Dr Chan is the Founder & CEO of PredictNow.ai Inc and a Managing Member of QTS Capital Management, LLC.

He has worked for various investment banks (Morgan Stanley, Credit Suisse, Maple) and hedge funds (Mapleridge, Millennium Partners, MANE) since 1997.

Dr Chan received his PhD in physics from Cornell University and was a member of IBM’s Human Language Technologies group before joining the financial industry. He was a co-founder and principal of EXP Capital Management, LLC, a Chicago-based investment firm.

Dr Chan is also the author of Quantitative Trading: How to Build Your Own Algorithmic Trading Business (Wiley), Algorithmic Trading: Winning Strategies and Their Rationale and his third and latest book is on Machine Trading: Deploying Computer Algorithms to Conquer the Markets.
